producer_report.summary: Each job now gets a read-only evidence snapshot at `<state>/jobs/<id>/evidence/`, written at dispatch. It holds `records/`, `landings/` and `history.json` (the last 200 first-parent commits of the base commit, each with hash, commit time, subject and trailers). It is locked with 0555/0444 modes and `chattr +i`, and write probes fail dispatch if a write still succeeds as root. The producer and verifier briefs name the path and say real-records checks use `athena status --snapshot <path>`. The stored briefs and their hash use a `<state>` placeholder, so no machine path is committed. `athena status --snapshot <dir>` shares one body with `status()`. Records, job state, head and throughput come from the snapshot. Sections that need the live repository or process state are omitted, with a note printed. The producer and verifier hook policies get a read-only root on the snapshot (`Policy.read_roots`), and Claude Code settings get `permissions.additionalDirectories`. The working copy stays without `records/`. I made no edit in this round. I reran the targeted tests and the policy scan on the existing edits, and added the missing explanation for `crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs`. I did not run clippy or the full suite; those are left to Athena's checks.

The `chattr` call is a shell-out in core. The edits to files outside the listed deliverables (athena-agent policy.rs, lib.rs and claude.rs, run/verification.rs, run/tests.rs, reading.rs, planning.rs, admission.rs, cli tests) are the ones the plan justifies.
mistakes: In the previous round I left crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs unchanged without explaining why. The explanation is now in unchanged_planned_files.
learnings: Tests run as root, so mode bits alone do not stop writes. The snapshot lock needs `chattr +i`, and the tests include an unlocked control to show that the protection is what refuses the write.
The policy test scan reads tracked files only, so new files need a manual grep for the banned words.
The hook policy denied reads outside the working directory, so the snapshot needed an explicit read-only root in the policies.
desires: A way to run Claude Code live to confirm it honours permissions.additionalDirectories under --restricted --permission-prompts none.
